status: Height classes read as DATA by src/encounter.rs (BOIL-A core). They are level-authoring classes, not physics: the actual jump arcs live in src/prototype.rs and are owned by DONUT-MOBILITY-01 (DM-A, not merged when this file was written), so a value that moves there moves here in one data edit. Sources: Carl 80 px (CF02-Q45 perches, apex 88.54 px); base Donut 112 px (DM-Q02 apex 114.92 px, a narrow human route; the AI attempts 104 px at most); boosted Donut 128 px (DP-Q14 / DP-Q18 apex 137.95 px). reach_x_px is a conservative flat-jump distance (below the running-jump distances of the same specs). ceiling_rule is DP-Q45.
